title: Stream segmentation metrics, trace-context propagation, and dynamic redaction for live tokens
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Problem: Our current streaming telemetry emits coarse request-level metrics and separate traces that do not map reliably to individual streamed chunks. This makes it hard to debug per-chunk latency spikes, correlate tool/function calls emitted mid-stream, and ensure PII is not leaked into logs when streams contain customer data.
goals: Emit per-segment (chunk) metrics with stable identifiers that map to tracing spans
Propagate W3C trace-context through streaming edges (router -> runtime -> backend kernels) so each produced chunk is linkable to a span
Implement a low-latency, configurable redaction hook that runs inline on streamed content before it reaches logs/metrics exporters
Keep added CPU/memory overhead within 5% for typical workloads and avoid increased tail latency > 10ms per request on p99
acceptance_criteria: Chunks emitted by the runtime contain chunk_id and parent_trace_id in telemetry and are visible in our chunk-level dashboard
Trace spans include chunk boundaries and can be queried end-to-end across services using existing trace IDs
Redaction plugin strips configured sensitive patterns from streamed logs and metrics while preserving structural tokens for downstream analytics
Benchmark: end-to-end p50/p95/p99 for text-streaming workloads shows <=5% CPU overhead and tail latency increase <=10ms compared to baseline without observability features
design_decisions: Use an append-only chunk_id (uuid4 hex) assigned at the router entry to avoid re-sequencing when batching coalesces tokens
Propagate parent trace-id via existing trace-context header and add chunk_id as a baggage field to reduce cross-service lookups
Implement redaction as a multi-stage filter: fast inline regex whitelist+deny for common PII, and an optional async deep-scrub pipeline for long-running compliance jobs
Emit metrics to Prometheus/OpenTelemetry as labels: chunk_id, model_variant, route, sample_flag. Avoid including raw token content in any label to prevent leaks
tradeoffs_and_risks: Inline redaction adds CPU cost; mitigated by sampling + fast-path whitelist
Adding chunk_id to baggage increases trace payload size; measured to be under 64 bytes per request on average
Edge case: heavy micro-batching can cause many small chunk IDs; we will normalize in exporter by grouping consecutive chunk_ids from same request for dashboarding
Compatibility: older clients without trace-context will get synthetic parent ids generated at the router; we will document behavior and provide a migration script
implementation_tasks: Router: generate stable chunk_id and attach as baggage -> 2025-01-20
Runtime: attach chunk boundary spans and emit per-chunk metrics -> 2025-01-28
Redaction: implement inline regex engine and pluggable ruleset loader (KMS-backed) -> 2025-02-02
Telemetry exporter: map chunk_id to logs/traces and add chunk-level histogram buckets -> 2025-02-06
Console: new chunk-level timeline visualization in rollouts dashboard -> 2025-02-12
E2E tests + benchmark harness for streaming workloads -> 2025-02-08
Docs: migration guide for clients and opt-in flags -> 2025-02-10
testing_plan: Unit tests for chunk_id generation, trace baggage propagation, and redactor regex engine
Integration tests simulating interleaved tool calls mid-stream to verify spans link correctly
Load testing at 1x, 5x, 10x baseline QPS to measure CPU/memory overhead and tail latency
Fuzz tests for regex rules to ensure no catastrophic backtracking on adversarial inputs
Privacy audit run with sample customers (opt-in) to validate redaction false-negative rate < 0.1%
monitoring_kpis: trace_link_rate (percent of chunks linked to trace)
rollout_plan: Feature gated behind runtime flag 'chunk_observability' default off
Canary: enable for internal accounts and 2 low-traffic customers for 48h
Observe KPIs, then expand to 10% of traffic, 50%, and full rollout over two weeks
Fail open policy for latency regressions: if p99 latency increases > 10ms or error rate increases > 0.5% revert the flag
Provide an opt-out parameter to disable inline redaction and route logs through the async scrubber instead
dependencies_notes: ENG-43890: OTLP exporter upgrade must land before full rollout
ENG-44012: kernel-level boundary annotations required for low-level span accuracy
